text: Looking after my nephew tonight while his parents are away and I just need a straight answer please, not a list of 'it depends'. He's 9, got chickenpox, spots came out yesterday. Temp is 38.3 right now, took it twice to be sure. He's itching like mad, mostly his back and tummy, and he will NOT settle to sleep, keeps getting up saying he cant get comfy. Apart from that he's absolutley fine, eating crisps, arguing with me about bedtime, normal him. His breathing is totaly normal, I've watched him, no problems there. I've got calpol in the cupboard and some of that pink lotion. Do I give the calpol for the temp and just keep him up till he drops off, or is there something else I should be doing? I don't want to ring his mum and panic her over nothing if this is just what chickenpox is like. Thanks
